title: Sha Tau Kok — A Journey Through History, Culture & Modern Transformation
description: Explore Sha Tau Kok with Qiu Yiyang. It is a secluded coastal enclave near Shenzhen blending ancient Hakka traditions and colonial relics like Chung Ying Street. Witness its evolution from a tranquil fishing village to a modern hub, where nature, history, and resilience converge.
